paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.37% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.05%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-1.47%). Brent crude changed +0.29% to 100.87. Gold changed -1.22% to 4,136.1001. Bitcoin changed -2.46% to 83,454.1562. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.316%, a relative move of +0.89%. Among the firms tracked, Deutsche Bank (-4.65%) and HSBC (-4.08%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Germany blocks Chinese acquisition in its largest seaport (FT World). Berlin rejects state-owned Cosco’s takeover of a Hamburg port logistics group ‘on security concerns’ Deals and capital markets: McKesson and CD&R strike $5.8bn deal to buy infusion services provider (FT Markets). Acquisition of Option Care Health is latest buyout of a healthcare services company trading below historic valuation multiples Central banks and macro: French central bank chief says ECB intervention not needed to ease bond rout (FT World). Emmanuel Moulin also hit out at ‘Trump-style’ threats against him from the far-left Central banks and macro: US oil trader takes $2bn gamble on tankers as carriers steer clear of Hormuz (FT World). American security push aims to spur Asian refining as diesel shortages stoke inflation Geopolitics and trade: How the US financed World War I using Charlie Chaplin and Girl Scouts (FT Markets). When the US entered the war in 1917, it faced a massive financial challenge: how to pay for its contribution?
